research_question: Under an exact shared DROID simulator state, do a standard VLA and a WAM follow left/right task language, retain control under a short paraphrase, and benefit differently from the same predicate-oracle hierarchy?

scope.paper_alignment: Success rate and final task progression follow Chen et al. arXiv:2602.13193. WAM future compliance, action-future agreement, strict pick-then-place, and effect-to-noise measurements are declared additions.
claim_exclusions: No conclusion about all VLAs or all WAMs.
No claim about in-distribution, motion, or semantic generalization.
No direct numerical comparison with the paper's Bridge real-robot results.
The predicate oracle isolates low-level hierarchical controllability; it is not a learned VLM reasoner.

models.action_schema: seven DROID joint-position targets plus gripper
seven DROID joint-position targets plus gripper

shared_environment.initial_relation: cube and bowl laterally neutral; neither requested predicate is true
shared_environment.prior_shared_state_check: 18 shared robot, object, and camera datasets had maximum absolute difference 0.0; Cosmos records four additional camera arrays

canonical.left: Put the rubiks cube to the left of the bowl
canonical.right: Put the rubiks cube to the right of the bowl

short_paraphrase.left: Put the cube left of the bowl
short_paraphrase.right: Put the cube right of the bowl

sampling.static_grid_formula: 2 models * 2 prompt wordings * 2 directions * 10 episode seeds
sampling.calibration_policy: Scorer and recorder calibration episodes use seed prefix 51xx, are stored separately, and are excluded from all confirmation estimates.
sampling.stopping_rule: Complete the fixed grid. Rerun only documented setup-invalid episodes. Do not select prompts, thresholds, or seeds from confirmation outcomes.

primary_metrics.binary_requested_goal_success_rate: successful predicate-terminated episodes / valid attempted episodes
final_paper_style_progression: picked or interacted with the correct cube at least once; credit persists
cube satisfies the requested left/right relation at episode end; credit is revoked if undone
primary_metrics.reporting: Report numerator, denominator, direction separately, wording separately, and a 95% Beta(1,1) posterior interval.

declared_secondary_metrics: predicted requested-relation rate per Cosmos future chunk
executed requested-relation rate over the corresponding action horizon
imagines requested and acts requested quadrant counts
semantic scorer coverage and uncertain count
inference, environment, wall-clock, memory, disk, and setup burden

semantic_future_evaluation.conditioning_frame: frame zero; never counted as future evidence
semantic_future_evaluation.requested_predicate: signed cube centroid minus bowl centroid in a calibrated over-shoulder view
semantic_future_evaluation.execution_target: RoboLab ground-truth cube/bowl state after the actions actually executed from that chunk
semantic_future_evaluation.uncertainty: A chunk without reliable cube and bowl tracks is labeled uncertain, excluded from semantic rate denominators, and included in coverage counts.
semantic_future_evaluation.validation: Freeze detector thresholds after excluded 51xx calibration data and audit a fixed contact sheet before confirmation.

hierarchical_condition.name: five_step_predicate_oracle

commands.not_holding_cube: Reach for and firmly grasp the rubiks cube
commands.holding_without_goal: Move the rubiks cube to the requested side of the bowl
commands.holding_at_goal: Open the gripper and release the rubiks cube

hierarchical_condition.comparison: For seeds 7100-7104, compare oracle outcomes with canonical static-task outcomes rerun under the same seeds and five-action replan horizon.
hierarchical_condition.interpretation: This tests low-level interface bandwidth under a perfect state-aware command selector, not learned reasoning quality.

retrospective: Efficient-WAM, FastWAM, LingBot-VA, earlier Cosmos, and earlier pi0.5 pilots
prospective: all outputs under artifacts/vla_wam_shared_v1 and corresponding RoboLab confirmation directories
